style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: HE crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY beat, talking ones too, the savanna streaking past HIM; HE fills half the frame height; camera rides beside HIM low, whipping over on each change of direction, new shot size and one impulse per beat; no push in, no rack focus, no held pose, no prop worked in place; FLY works at lens, never the subject
character: a burly iridescent scarab beetle, ridged horn, six scraping legs, dusty, utterly serious
second_characters: ONE plump dung fly in a tie, hauling a crumb at lens all clip, running with him, never still; ONE shaggy warthog trotting the far background trail in every beat, small behind him, dropping a fresh pat as it goes
props: ONE huge matte dung ball, half his height; fresh pats on THE HOG trail; ONE flat rock right of frame; ONE crumb-sized gold coin packed inside THE BALL; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: THE BALL is under him or beside him in every beat, never parked; THE HOG stays far behind, small, never at lens; the coin is buried and unseen until 8.95; the rock stands right of frame from 0.0
environment: a sun-baked savanna floor, dry grass, a cracked termite mound, wide bright sky

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: weary chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.75-3.3 one breath; pause 3.3-4.0; 4.0-7.35 one breath; after 7.35 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: THE BALL grinding on dry earth, six legs scrabbling, hooves thudding behind, a wet plop at 4.6, a dry crack at 8.15, a husk tearing at 8.95, one thin coin ping at 9.4, cicadas

timeline.a: he shoulders THE BALL and drives it left to right along the whole frame, earth blasting from under his legs, FLY at lens, THE HOG trotting the trail behind
he rams THE BALL right to left on his hind legs, grass whipping past him, FLY at lens
he vaults onto THE BALL and rides it left to right, legs pedalling, the mound and THE HOG streaking behind
THE BALL throws him and he skids right to left on his back after it, FLY taking the dirt in the face
he hauls THE BALL left to right up the flank of the mound, hind legs churning, and swipes a fresh pat off THE HOG trail onto THE BALL without breaking stride
THE BALL breaks loose and he tears right to left after it down the slope
he heads THE BALL left to right straight at lens, FLY slinging out of the way
he boots THE BALL right to left into the rock and it splits with a crack, he running on beside the halves
he chases the two halves left to right, hooking one with his horn on the run, FLY at lens
he rips the halves apart at lens right to left and ONE crumb-sized coin drops out; he catches it on the run and bites it, and it bends double in his jaws

must_appear: THE HOG trots the far background and drops a fresh pat by 0.75; at 4.0-5.4 he swipes a pat onto THE BALL on the run; THE BALL under him or beside him in every beat; at 7.35 it splits on the rock while he keeps running; at 8.95 he rips the halves apart at lens and ONE crumb-sized gold coin falls out; he catches it on the run, bites it, it bends double, his face to camera
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, black bands, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a still background animal, duplicate props, a held pose, a prop worked in place, slow motion, a broken ball before 7.35, speech after 7.35
